fields.why: VE and control vaccination percentages are reported for three age groups (6 months–17 years, 18–64, ≥65), and the text says vaccination 'varied by VE network, patient age, and setting'.
Race/ethnicity and sex appear only as model covariates.

The CI-inversion tests are vaccinated vs unvaccinated within each stratum, not across age groups, so the flag is a false alarm. A's quotes cite the ≥65 vs 18–64 'similar' statement, a pair; the 'varied by ... patient age' sentence is the better evidence.
